description: This file contains serialization utility functions for string conversions, hex and base64 encoding/decoding, and Unicode code point handling within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts wide character string to std::string, handling platform-specific conversions.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts multibyte character string to std::wstring, handling platform-specific conversions.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts wchar_t array to std::string with specified length, considering Unicode compilation settings.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts char array to std::string with specified length, considering Unicode compilation settings.

methods.name: ToHexString
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into a hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: FromHexString
methods.description: Decodes a hexadecimal string into a byte array.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into a base64 string, with optional padding.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string into a byte array, with support for ignore list characters.

methods.name: CodePointToUTF16
methods.description: Converts a Unicode code point to UTF-16 surrogate pair if necessary.

methods.name: UTF16ToCodePoint
methods.description: Converts a UTF-16 surrogate pair to a Unicode code point.

methods.name: ToCodePoint
methods.description: Decodes a UTF-8 sequence into a Unicode code point.

methods.name: FromCodePoint
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode code point into a UTF-8 sequence.

methods.name: ToQuotedString
methods.description: Escapes internal quote characters in a string and wraps it with quotes.
